name: Oregon
agency: Oregon Department of Transportation (ODOT), Driver and Motor Vehicle Services (DMV)
permitAge: 15 (instruction permit); 16 for a license (Oregon Driver Manual 2026-2027, p. 89)

teen.supervisedHours: 100 hours, or 50 hours plus an ODOT-approved traffic safety education course (manual p. 90). The manual does not set a night-hours minimum.
teen.nightLimit: Provisional license, first year: no driving 12 midnight to 5 a.m. except between home and work, home and a school event with no other transport, for employment, or with a licensed driver at least 25 (ORS 807.122; not in the manual)
teen.passengerLimit: Provisional license: first 6 months no passengers under 20 except immediate family; second 6 months no more than 3 passengers under 20 who are not family. Not applied with a parent or stepparent with valid privileges, or a certified traffic safety education instructor (ORS 807.122; not in the manual).
teen.phone: Drivers under 18: no cell phone or mobile electronic device at all while driving. Drivers 18 and over: hands-free accessory only (manual p. 80).

notes: Checked against the Oregon Driver Manual 2026-2027 (ODOT DMV form 37, English PDF; Spanish edition form 37s). Printed page = PDF page minus 8.

Knowledge test (manual p. 2): 35 multiple-choice questions, 28 correct to pass. Taken online at DMV2U or at a DMV office; offered in several languages, with or without audio (languages not listed in the manual). Spanish kept true: a Spanish manual exists and 2025 legislative testimony reports Spanish-language Class C pass rates.
Permit supervisor: licensed, at least 21, licensed at least 3 years, in the seat beside the driver.
Statutory speeds (ODOT Speed Zones): 20 mph business districts and school zones, 25 mph residential districts, 15 mph alleys and narrow residential roadways.

Move-over law (ORS 811.147, 2025 edition) is not in the manual: change to a non-adjacent lane or slow to at least 5 mph under the speed limit for any stopped vehicle showing warning or hazard lights, flares or emergency signs.
